title: Floodplain Rules, Public Input & City Process
meeting_type: Council Transition Work Group Regular Meeting
summary:
*   **Floodplain Variance Discussions**: Proposed dedicating specific meetings to review exceptions for development in flood-prone areas.
*   **Public Engagement Update**: Received an update on efforts to improve how residents can participate in city decision-making.
*   **City Procedure Review**: Discussed streamlining internal processes, including committee referrals and policies for postponing agenda items.
